headline: PHP patches two critical flaws as hackers exploit them early, CISA confirms attacks
summary: PHP's maintainers issued emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities, dubbed PHP2Shell, prompting website operators and some governments to take sites offline as a precaution. Reports say AI tools helped researchers find the flaws, and that attackers began probing them roughly four days before patches shipped. The US cybersecurity agency CISA later added the flaws to its exploited-vulnerabilities catalog and ordered federal agencies to patch, as a separate, lower-priority third bug was also reported.
